title: Christa Pike 'angry and confused' after failed execution, lawyers say
description: Lawyers say the convicted killer was surprised to have survived and remained "shackled" to her hospital bed.

title: Watch: What we know about Christa Pike's ‘shock’ recovery in hospital
description: The US death row inmate's legal team said at a press conference that she is now "conscious and speaking" after her failed execution.

title: Badenoch says Tories would scrap inheritance tax on family homes
description: Tory leader says her party is "coming back", as she aims to convince voters it has changed after 2024 election defeat.

title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
description: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years in September.

title: Burnham to hold security talks with German chancellor in Berlin
description: Downing Street said deeper co-operation in the face of rising hybrid threats from Russia would be high on the agenda during Burnham's first official visit to Germany.

title: We spent thousands on a Tui river cruise but ended up on coach trips
description: Passengers have described their anger after their itineraries changed to involve hours spent on coach trips instead.

title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.

title: Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro expected to face more charges this week
description: The new charges are expected to accuse Maduro and his wife of playing a role in the torture of Americans in Venezuelan prisons, US media reports.

title: Man charged with 13 attempted murders including British child after Alps attack
description: Abdalmasih Hanoun, accused of carrying out an attack at a French park in 2023, is set to face trial.
